# Scribbl3D

> Scribbl3D is an India-based 3D printing store and service provider in Nangloi, Delhi. It sells 3D printers, filaments, resins, and prebuilt 3D printed products, and offers design, prototyping, small-batch manufacturing, and personalised 3D printing services.

For current products, prices, and stock, use the live pages below. A full product index with current price ranges is available at [llms-full.txt](https://www.scribbl3d.com/llms-full.txt).

## Shop

- [3D Printer Filaments](https://www.scribbl3d.com/filament): Filaments by material and colour, with diameter and spool-weight options
- [3D Printer Resins](https://www.scribbl3d.com/resins): Resins by colour and bottle weight
- [3D Printers](https://www.scribbl3d.com/printers): 3D printers with specifications, features, and downloads
- [Prebuilt 3D Printed Products](https://www.scribbl3d.com/prebuilt-products): Ready-made 3D printed products with colour and size options

## Services

- [3D Printing Services](https://www.scribbl3d.com/services): Design, prototyping, and small-batch manufacturing requests
- [Personalised 3D Printing](https://www.scribbl3d.com/personalise): Submit a personalised or custom product request

## Policies

- [Shipping Policy](https://www.scribbl3d.com/shipping-policy): Ships within India; orders are generally delivered within 7 days (estimates, not guarantees)
- [Returns Policy](https://www.scribbl3d.com/return-policy): Eligible products may be returned or exchanged within 10 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging; 3D printers and electronic products are not returnable after delivery; opened consumables are not returnable unless defective or damaged; customised products have separate conditions
- [Refund & Cancellation Policy](https://www.scribbl3d.com/refund-policy): Cancellation before dispatch; approved refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5–7 business days
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.scribbl3d.com/terms-conditions)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.scribbl3d.com/privacy-policy)
